description: Domaine Collotte's 2015 Marsannay Boivin is an aromatic Pinot Noir with abundant red fruit and a subtle smoky cast. The entry is supple before a more taut, persistent finish brings definition.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2015 Domaine Collotte Marsannay Boivin.
palate: Supple attack, fresh fruit, fine structure
sommelierNotes: Serve at 15-16°C with hard cheese and onion confit, a country salad, or crisp roasted potatoes.
